raw_segments.text: Edgar, draw thy sword, that if my speech offend a noble heart, thy arm may do thee justice.
Behold, it is the privilege of mine honors, my oath, and my profession.
I protest, maugher thy strength, youth, place, and eminence, despite thy victor sword and
fire new fortune, thy valor and thy heart, thou art a traitor.
False to thy gods, thy brother and thy father.
Conspirant, gains't this high illustrious prince.
And from the extremist upward of thy head to the descent and dust beneath thy foot,
Say thou no, this sword, this arm, and my best spirits are bent to prove upon thy heart,
